_comment: R32 for C1: one single-edit mutant per invariant this task's cases claim. `node tests/c/run-mutants.mjs` applies each to a temporary copy and requires a case the mutant DECLARES to fail on an assertion; the cases come from the exported conformance functions run against C1's services and from this track's own tests. A kill that arrives only because the boundary guard turned a thrown error into `internal_error` must say so with `kills_by: "guarded"`, a file-level failure is a runner error, and a suite that passes unchanged is a survival. A claimed invariant with no mutant, or a mutant with no case, is the defect this list exists to prevent.
